SafariZone_East_Text_OnybrisGrunt1Intro.en: This park is under ONYBRIS control!
SafariZone_East_Text_OnybrisGrunt1Intro.fr: Ce parc est sous le contrôle\nd'ONYBRIS !

SafariZone_East_Text_OnybrisGrunt1Post.en: The old WARDEN hid something.\nWe will find it!
SafariZone_East_Text_OnybrisGrunt1Post.fr: Le vieux GARDIEN a caché quelque\nchose. Nous le trouverons !

SafariZone_East_Text_OnybrisGrunt2Post.en: The SAFARI staff ran away like\nscared RATTATA.
SafariZone_East_Text_OnybrisGrunt2Post.fr: Le personnel du SAFARI s'est enfui\ncomme des RATTATA effrayés.

SafariZone_East_Text_TimeDeclinesOnlyWhi.en: TRAINER TIPS\pThe remaining time declines only\nwhile you walk.
SafariZone_East_Text_TimeDeclinesOnlyWhi.fr: CONSEILS AUX DRESSEURS\pLe temps restant ne diminue que\nquand tu marches.
